title: 区域生态圈负责人/Local Ecosystem Lead

titleByLocale.it: 区域生态圈负责人/Responsabile dell'ecosistema locale
titleByLocale.en: 区域生态圈负责人/Local Ecosystem Lead
titleByLocale.de: 区域生态圈负责人 / Lokales Ökosystem

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position 您是谁： 作为生态圈负责人，你将负责管理生态圈资源，并率领区域生态圈团队服务客户，建立内外部合作，实现区域生态圈罗氏全产品组合策略目标，最终提高患者获益。 您的主要职责：
• 基于区域生态群属地策略，制定本生态圈发展目标，并对目标的负责实施计划和跟进有效性
• 率领团队与客户建立广泛的合作和信任，并共同为罗氏产品组合相关领域的规范诊疗水平提高而积极采取行动
• 同生态圈合作伙伴合作，提高当地生态圈医疗质量，提升患者获益 •加入生态圈管理委员会，参与区域生态群人员及业务管理，并率领团队制定并执行相应计划 •吸引，辅导和发展生态圈各角色职能的团队成员，实现生态圈人才的复合性发展 我们期待这样的你加入：
• 充分践行领导者的角色，即远见者，架构师，教练及促成者
• 业务及资源规划能力
• 良好的沟通&高效整合资源能力 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
